source.publisher: Devon County Council / Devon & Dartmoor Historic Environment Record

evidence_slice: Devon County Council's official public Other Useful Layers service exposes layer 669 as Listed buildings, an esriGeometryPolygon feature layer maintained by the Devon & Dartmoor Historic Environment Record, with fields including ListEntry, Name, Grade and Shape. The selected single-record window targets ListEntry 1104037 in outer Exeter/Pinhoe. The exact GeoJSON query could not be retrieved through the available web channel, and a direct network attempt failed at DNS resolution before any feature payload was returned. Therefore no geometry, record attributes, or physical-footprint acceptance was fabricated.

field_evidence.footprint: Official DCC layer 669 is declared as esriGeometryPolygon with a Shape geometry field, but the exact ListEntry 1104037 query yielded no readable feature payload.
field_evidence.type_use: Official DCC layer 669 declares Name as its display field and includes ListEntry, Name and Grade attributes; the target is the Pinhoe listed-building record 1104037, but no exact record payload was readable.
